paper.title: EgoVLA: Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Egocentric Human Videos

claim: 在 EgoVLA 的 ego 视频预训练混合中，手部姿态标注较噪的 HoloAssist 被刻意下采样至 1/10，以避免噪声标注源过度代表；即标注噪声通过降权而非清洗来缓解。

evidence.summary: 作者在数据集构建中明确说明 HoloAssist 手部标注更噪，并因此均匀下采样至 1/10 以平衡任务与来源。
evidence.short_quote: To avoid overrepresentation of HoloAssist, which has noisier labels, we uniformly sampled 1/10 of it to balance tasks and sources.

evidence.short_quote: Egocentric videos introduce challenges for learning due to continuous camera motion. To mitigate this, we use world-frame camera poses to project future wrist positions into the current camera frame, ensuring consistent supervision.
